name: Anastasiia
text: The hosts are just the best I ever had! Mara and Beppe took care of me and my sister fully. The apartment was spotless and so cosy we felt completely at home.

name: Khrystyna
text: We had a really nice stay. The house is beautiful, clean, with attention to the smallest details and excellently organised, with everything you need to feel at ease. The owners are truly wonderful people: kind, welcoming and always available to help with anything you need. They made us feel welcome from the very beginning and made our stay even more enjoyable. It is an accommodation that absolutely deserves to be chosen. Thank you so much for your hospitality!.

name: Emilie
text: Very cozy and nice apartment for accommodation for two adults and two children. Great and newly renovated and clean facilities. Nothing was missing! Was dishwasher and washing machine available! The host was very helpful and pleasant despite his limited English skills. The location was in a cozy village a little up in the mountains on a narrow road. Parking a little way from the apartment (be careful not to drive too far, because the parking lot is on the left side of the road on the way up)! :)

name: Kevin960
text: Really pleasant stay. The owners were very kind and very professional, always available for any need. The property was very clean and well maintained. Highly recommended!
